title: Motie van het lid Beckerman over een bevoegde instantie aanwijzen om ook deepfakeporno en andere onrechtmatige seksuele beelden offline te halen

reading.body:
A system that generates or hosts deepfake pornography was deployed with no mechanism to verify the consent or identity of the people depicted. The system created and distributed non-consensual sexual imagery of named individuals, including public figures and politicians. This is a failure of basic output filtering and content moderation at the point of generation and hosting.

The deployment failed at multiple stages where human oversight could have prevented harm. No review process checked whether the system was being used to create illegal content before it was made available to an audience of millions. No moderation system removed the content after it was created and published. The system appears to have operated without legal compliance checks despite deepfake pornography being established as illegal in the Netherlands.

It is not established who created or operated the system, what technical measures if any were considered, or whether the platform's operators knew the content violated laws before complaints were filed.

summary:
Multiple Dutch celebrities are considering legal action after discovering they appear in fake pornographic videos on an online platform that receives approximately 13 million monthly visitors. The manipulated content features the faces of female entertainers, television presenters, Olympic athletes, government officials, mayors, and members of the royal family. The interim Minister of Justice called the videos "sickening" and urged victims to file reports with authorities. Several victims have already filed complaints or are exploring legal options to address the violation.

Deepfake pornography falls under revenge porn laws and is therefore illegal in the Netherlands. Experts recommend that victims file police reports, which could lead authorities to shut down the website hosting such material. Additional options available to victims include starting a collective lawsuit, submitting complaints to the data protection authority, or contacting hosting companies. Previously, television presenter Welmoed Sijtsma pursued action against someone who created fake videos of her, resulting in a 39-year-old man from Amersfoort receiving a conditional sentence of 180 hours of community service in November.
title_en: Motion by member Beckerman on designating a competent authority to also remove deepfake pornography and other unlawful sexual images offline
